Added: A "+" at the end of the tab row opens a menu with New studio and New PR review
Fixed: A browser tab stays on its repo: clicking an alert for another repo no longer switches the tab you are in, it opens that repo in a new browser tab or the tab that already has it
Each browser tab keeps its own appearance (colour) and repo across a reload, and another tab's choice no longer changes it; a new tab starts from the last one chosen

whats_new.title: Tabs keep their own repo and colour
whats_new.text: A new browser tab starts from your last repo and colour, then keeps its own: changing them in one tab no longer changes another. A finished-review alert for another repo opens in its own tab instead of moving the one you are in. The tab row ends with a + for a new studio or PR review.
